  {"step":2,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/readclause.c","function":"ReadClause","line":555,"var":"option_ssml","code":"if ((option_ssml) && (phoneme_mode == 0)) {","note":"The synthesis path enables SSML parsing, so '<...>' sequences in the input are interpreted as tags."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/readclause.c","function":"ReadClause","line":602,"var":"xml_buf","code":"terminator = ProcessSsmlTag(xml_buf, buf, &ix, n_buf, xmlbase, &audio_text, voice_change, &base_voice, base_voice_variant_name, &ignore_text, &clear_skipping_text, &sayas_mode, &sayas_start, ssml_stack, &n_ssml_stack, &n_param_stack, (int *)speech_parameters);","note":"Each parsed SSML tag is dispatched to the tag processor with the current output buffer and stack state."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":814,"var":"attr1=src","code":"if ((attr1 = GetSsmlAttribute(px, \"src\")) != NULL) {","note":"For <audio>, the src attribute is extracted from attacker-controlled markup and copied into a local filename buffer."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":821,"var":"buf/fname","code":"index = LoadSoundFile2(fname);","note":"The extracted path is used to load a sound file, making the file contents reachable through the audio-icon cache."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/soundicon.c","function":"LoadSoundFile2","line":160,"var":"fname","code":"if (((soundicon_tab[ix].filename != NULL) && strcmp(fname, soundicon_tab[ix].filename) == 0)) {","note":"The loader compares the requested path against cached entries and may reuse an existing slot for the same attacker-chosen filename."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/soundicon.c","function":"LoadSoundFile","line":94,"var":"length","code":"length = GetFileLength(fname);","note":"The file length is measured and then used to allocate and read the entire file into memory."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/soundicon.c","function":"LoadSoundFile","line":116,"var":"p","code":"ip = (int *)(&p[40]); soundicon_tab[index].length = (*ip) / 2;","note":"The code trusts the WAV header at a fixed offset to derive the sample count from the loaded bytes."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/soundicon.c","function":"LoadSoundFile","line":117,"var":"soundicon_tab[index].data","code":"soundicon_tab[index].data = p;","note":"The loaded file bytes are stored in the sound-icon table for later playback."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":833,"var":"sp->parameter[espeakSILENCE]","code":"sp->parameter[espeakSILENCE] = 1;","note":"The <audio> tag marks the current clause as silent while the cached audio is queued for playback."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/soundicon.c","function":"LookupSoundicon","line":129,"var":"soundicon_tab[ix].data","code":"if (soundicon_tab[ix].length == 0) { if (LoadSoundFile(NULL, ix, NULL) != ENS_OK) { return -1; } }","note":"When the cached sound icon is later used, the loader may lazily reload the same file bytes from disk."},
  {"step":12,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/soundicon.c","function":"LoadSoundFile","line":107,"var":"p","code":"if (fread(p, 1, length, f) != length) {","note":"The vulnerable sink is the raw file read into the heap buffer; malformed or truncated audio data can drive the heap-buffer-overflow read reported by ASan."}
]
